content.comment_body: Hello everyone, could someone tell me if [product_name] software provides a timer function similar to TONR? For example, I'd like to set a preset time of 50 seconds, so when I1 is on for 5 seconds, the timer runs for 5 seconds. If I1 is activated again, the timer should resume from the 6th second, retaining the previous 5 seconds instead of resetting.
Hi, you can implement a timer like this by combining an asynchronous pulse generator with a counter to track elapsed time.

analysis.insight_summary: A user inquired if [product_name] software offers a retentive timer function similar to TONR timers in conventional controllers, so that elapsed time is stored even if the input is toggled multiple times. Another forum member proposed building the functionality manually using a combination of an asynchronous pulse generator and a counter.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking built-in support for a retentive timer feature within [product_name], specifically one that accumulates elapsed time over successive activations without resetting.
